sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Pedestrian Safety

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Signals rule crossings from curb waits, mid-block crossings stay banned, and crosswalks keep right [A01].
Why it matters: group crossing-rules; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F01, sec12-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
Sidewalks come first, left-side facing traffic comes without sidewalks, and stepping off comes with traffic [A01].
Why it matters: group walking-place; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A01
Crossing outside crosswalks yields to all vehicles, as does skipping provided tunnels and overpasses [A01].
Why it matters: group crossing-yield; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F02; confusables sec12-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A01
White canes mark only blind or disabled walkers, and road soliciting bans everything but authorized charity [A01].
Why it matters: group pedestrian-conduct; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A01
Darting stays banned, night wants light clothes and reflectors, and alcohol stays off walkways [A01].
Why it matters: group pedestrian-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A01
Crossing walkers earn slowed horned readiness, while cane walkers earn precautions up to mandatory full stops [A01].
Why it matters: group motorist-duties; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F07, sec12-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0067]
